challengeFindings.title: A user whose git config sets core.hooksPath=~/.githooks (an existing directory git expands and runs hooks from) gets hooksMissing "~/.githooks" and a stderr line telling the agent the commit and push hooks do not run and to run the package install, on every adopted setup

After debug in place on dev from a linked worktree closes and releases its lock, its shared-checkout record stays under .git/worktrees/{name}/bkit/shared-checkout/{fid}.json, so a later bkit branches push --mode=dev from that worktree with no --fid picks the stale record and exits 0 with "nothing to push" instead of refusing with no record

Plan or design adopted on a branch whose name is also a top-level path (for example docs or scripts), while local dev is ahead of origin/dev, exits 7 with "cannot inspect unpublished dev work for docs: fatal: ambiguous argument 'docs': both revision and filename" even when the branch carries none of those commits

From a linked worktree that does not hold the run, statusLocation returns that worktree's committed copy of the FID's log directory (status logs are tracked and land on dev, so any branch cut after an earlier phase landed carries it) instead of the main checkout's live run, so failState appends workflow-failed to the stale copy and resolveActiveRun --fid misses the live run

tests.testName: does not report a ~ hooks directory that exists

challengeFindings.title: A user whose core.hooksPath points outside the checkout (~/.githooks or /opt/git-hooks, which TASK 9 now expands) and whose directory is missing gets a stderr line saying the directory is missing in the worktree and telling the agent to run the package install there, which cannot create a directory outside the checkout, so the agent spends an install and the same warning returns on the next adopted setup

A checked-out branch named `--output=src/index.ts` (a cloned repo's default branch can carry the name) makes adopted plan / design setup run `git rev-list --output=src/index.ts --not origin/dev`, which empties that file and skips the unpushed-`dev` refusal
